What's New

Version 7.0.0 January 2, 2026

Quality Refinement Release
  • User-Friendly Errors - Clear, helpful error messages with recovery actions
  • Save Status - Visual save indicator with Saving/Saved/Failed states
  • Confirmations - Enhanced confirmation dialogs for destructive actions
  • Empty States - Helpful guidance when lists are empty
  • Success Feedback - Clear confirmations for completed actions
  • First-Use Experience - Enhanced welcome for new users
  • Keyboard Navigation - Full keyboard support with shortcuts
  • Version Info - Version visible in About section

Quick Reference

Quick Bar

  • Edit/Play Toggle between editing and play mode (locks fields)
  • Adv/Dis Set global advantage or disadvantage for all rolls
  • Heal/Dmg Quickly add or remove HP
  • More ▾ Access rest options, extra stats, and map

Dice Rolls

  • Click any skill, save, or stat to roll with modifiers
  • Init Click the Initiative stat to roll initiative
  • Adv/Dis affects all rolls until changed back to Normal

Map

  • V Select / Pan tool
  • O Place character origin
  • L Mark last seen location
  • M Measure distance between two points
  • R Draw travel routes
  • P Add location pins
  • S Calibrate map scale
  • Esc Close map or cancel tool action

Characters

  • + New Create a new character
  • ⋯ Menu Duplicate or delete current character
  • Export Save character to a JSON file
  • Import Load character from a file

Keyboard Shortcuts

  • Ctrl+Z Undo last change
  • Ctrl+S Force save (auto-saves anyway)
  • Ctrl+P Print / Save as PDF
  • ? Open this help panel
  • Esc Close modals and menus

      🧙 Character Builder Answer questions to create your character prompt
      Step 1 of 8

      What's the core concept of your character?

      Describe in a sentence or two who this character is at their heart.

      What species/race is your character?

      Choose from common D&D species or describe a custom one.

      What class will your character be?

      Select a class and optionally a subclass. What level should they be?

      What is your character's background?

      Select a background or create a custom one. What did they do before adventuring?

      Describe your character's personality

      What are their personality traits, ideals, bonds, and flaws?

      How does your character approach combat?

      What's their fighting style and what stats should they prioritize?

      Tell us your character's backstory

      Where are they from? What shaped them? Why did they become an adventurer?

      Any additional details?

      Add any other important information about your character.
